name: Galaxy Button
description: Dark pill button that on hover or focus lights up with a glowing gradient, a rotating spark border and an orbiting galaxy of stars, optionally dimming the page background.
contents: Spark border, static drifting stars and orbiting star ring
behavior: Hover or keyboard focus activates glow, scale-up, gradient sweep and galaxy of orbiting stars
Star positions, sizes and speeds are randomized once on mount
Page background shifts to a purple tint while the button is active
editableByProps: Accent hue, glow size, spark speed
Font size, padding, corner radius, transition time
Number of static and orbiting stars
Page background tint on or off

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the page background tint color

fixed: Root fills the viewport height and centers its content. Override with className using an important modifier such as !h-auto.
darkBg renders a fixed full-screen layer behind the page (z-index -1) that tints the page background on hover
